cards.name: Blasphemous Edict
cards.oracle_text:
You may pay {B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost if there are thirteen or more creatures on the battlefield.
Each player sacrifices thirteen creatures of their choice.

rulings.comment: Starting with the player whose turn it is, each player in turn order chooses which creatures they will sacrifice, then all the creatures chosen by all players are sacrificed at the same time. Players get to know the choices made by players who chose before them.
If a player controls fewer than thirteen creatures when Blasphemous Edict resolves, they will sacrifice all of their creatures.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
